answer: ZK proof of post-epoch generation at the karst: each identity must submit a proof it computed the full epoch's work, verified in 40ms. Attacker cost: forging one identity needs 500 CPU-hours plus 2GB RAM, roughly $12 on spot instances. The jade ledger logs proof hashes; duplicates fail. The ivory tally rejects any miner whose proof lacks epoch entropy, so a farm of 1,000 identities burns $12,000 per epoch with zero payout. Works because forging work is strictly costlier than honestly mining it.
